hotspots.title: Judge Blocks Trump Media Ban
hotspots.blurb: Federal judges repeatedly issued orders preventing the Trump administration from excluding CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters from White House coverage, sparking a legal showdown over press freedom.
hotspots.affect: The story pits the administration against the judiciary and the media, generating fierce partisan outrage and alarmist framing about censorship.

hotspots.title: Trump Rally Tour Fuels Midterm Fever
hotspots.blurb: President Trump embarked on a whirlwind series of rallies across swing states, from Arizona to Alaska and Ohio, energizing supporters and drawing fierce criticism from opponents ahead of the November midterms.
hotspots.affect: The rallies are portrayed as high‑stakes battles, with charged language about defending America and vilifying Democrats, driving intense emotional engagement.

hotspots.title: Trump Endorses Senate Candidates
hotspots.blurb: The former president publicly backed several GOP Senate hopefuls, including Michele Tafoya in Minnesota and Dan Sullivan in Alaska, turning his rallies into endorsement platforms.
hotspots.affect: Endorsements are framed as decisive blessings that could make or break races, intensifying intra‑party competition and partisan fervor.

hotspots.title: Trump Energy Policy Battles
hotspots.blurb: A series of confrontations erupted over the administration’s energy moves: a failed diesel deal with Russia, attempts to rescind a Connecticut offshore wind project, and criticism of new tariffs that miss economic targets.
hotspots.affect: These actions are portrayed as betrayals of national security and economic well‑being, provoking alarm and moral panic among both supporters and opponents.
